title: AgentHarnessSurfaces
description: The AI surfaces an agent harness reaches, and whether each has called OpenMetadata lately, returned by `GET /v1/agentHarness/surfaces`.

surfaceId.description: An AI surface that can connect to OpenMetadata.

surfaceStatus.description: Connected when the surface called an MCP tool in the last 7 days. The surface names itself in its User-Agent, so this is a usage signal and not attestation.

skills.description: The surface loads the plugin's skill.

connector.description: The surface connects to the OpenMetadata MCP server.

hooks.description: The surface runs the plugin's hooks, which deliver the harness at each event.

lastSeenAt.description: Time of the surface's latest MCP tool call in the last 7 days (epoch millis, UTC). Absent when there was none.

lastPluginVersion.description: Plugin version the surface last reported. Absent when the surface does not report one.
